isa.description: Version of the JAsm Instruction-Set-Architecture used. Use `<newest>` to automatically select the newest version found, or install an even newer version, if wanted. For more information, see https://jasm-development.github.io/docs/jasm-config/fields#isa.

authors.description: Names of all major authors working on this project.

version.description: Version of the JASM Tooling, including the Assembler and Emulator. For versions, see https://www.github.com/jasm-development/jasm/releases.

items.description: Glob for the path to be excluded when using the `--validate-all` or `--assemble-all` flag.

exclude.description: Globs of the paths to be excluded when using the `--validate-all` or `--assemble-all` flag. For more about these flags, see https://jasm-development.github.io/docs/flags#validate-all and https://jasm-development.github.io/docs/flags#assemble-all.

preamble.description: Path to the file acting as the preamble for the project. See https://jasm-development.github.io/docs/preamble.

entry.description: Main entry point for the project. All files included in this file will be assembled as well, unless the `--assemble-all` is used, in which case all files not excluded will be assembled. See https://jasm-development.github.io/docs/entrypoint for more information.

each.description: Treat every file as a single project. Defaults to false. If files are seen seperately by tooling, fields like exclude, entry and root wll not apply.

location.description: Location to install the built dependency files, seen from the project root. Use `<std>` to add it to the standart library. Defaults to `./include`. See https://jasm-development.github.io/docs/jman for more.

root.description: Location of the root of this project, seen from the total project root. Defaults to the root of the folder which contains this file.

debug.description: Command line to be used for debug purposes. Should start with `jasm`, e.g. `jasm assemble main.jasm --no-stdlib --o=0 --annotated --debug`.

release.description: Command line to be used for releases. Should start with `jasm`, e.g. `jasm assemble main.jasm --no-stdlib --o=3 --compressed-out`.

test.description: Command line to be used for testing assembled files in the `./tests` directory. Should start with `jasm`, e.g. `jasm assemble ./tests/* --project --out-directory=./tests/out/; jasm emulate ./tests/out/* --dump-fail`.

cmd.description: Commands to be used in various situations, e.g. 'debug', 'release' and 'test'. If none of these is set, commands like `jasm debug`, `jasm release` and `jasm test` won't work unless additional arguments are provided.
